data.name: Heroes of Might & Magic V: Hammers of Fate
data.detailed_description:
Take part in a thrilling new adventure in the world of Ashan with the Hammers of Fate expansion. Discover uncharted territories and experience new ways of playing Heroes of Might & Magic V.

  • Introducing a brand-new Dwarves faction, made up of heroic warriors and rune magic adepts who stalk the deepest mountains and most hostile regions of the North.
  • Featuring 15 new missions, new heroes, and improved cut-scenes.
  • Includes new spells and abilities, 5 new single-player maps, 10 new multiplayer maps, new buildings, new artifacts, and new neutral creatures.
  • Thanks to new features such as Caravans and a random map generator, you will enjoy an even smoother experience and unlimited replayability. In addition, the simultaneous turn feature will speed up your online games.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimo:

  • Sistemas operativos suportados: apenas Windows 2000/XP
  • Processador: Pentium 4 ou AMD Athlon a 1,5 GHz
  • Memória: 512 MB
  • Placa gráfica: placa de 64 MB, compatível com DirectX 9
  • Versão DirectX: DirectX 9.0 ou superior
  • Som: compatível com DirectX 9.0
  • Disco rígido: 2 GB ou mais de espaço livre em disco
  • Multi-jogador: ligação de banda larga com 64 Kbps de upstream
  • *Placas gráficas suportadas à data de lançamento: NVIDIA GeForce série 3/4/FX/6 (GeForce 4 MX não suportada), ATI Radeon série 8500/9000/X, Matrox Parhelia
  • As versões para computador portátil destes chipsets poderão funcionar mas não são suportadas. Estes chipsets são, de momento, os únicos capazes de correr este jogo.
Originally released for Windows 7, the game can be played on Windows 10 and Windows 11 OS
